Method of Attack: Injecting advertisements into websites visited by the user
Using a rootkit to prevent viewing and removal of the adware
Using WMI to hide hijacking methods
Discoverer: Djordje Lukic, a malware analyst for Zemana
Impacted Systems: Windows systems (implied by C:\Program Files\ path and use of GMER)
Indicators of Compromise: Injected advertisements in various websites including Nytimes.com
Error message when accessing infected folders ('parameter is incorrect')
Hidden rootkit drivers detected by GMER
Folder C:\Program Files\Giolmujiwecder inaccessible until rootkits disabled
